in_marathi.name: Jitendr
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jitendr हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jitendra is a name of Sanskrit origin meaning 'Victory, Success'. It is derived from the words 'jita' (victory) and 'indra' (lord). In Hindu mythology, Indra is the king of the gods, associated with thunder, lightning, and rain. Jitendra is a powerful name, symbolizing triumph and achievement.
